## Awards {#awards}

### CIBSE Building Simulation Award 2024 {#cibse-award}

I received the **2024 CIBSE Building Simulation Award** for work on multi-scale modelling of air-source heat-pump impacts on outdoor microclimates under 2050s UK scenarios.

The [research explainer](../research/heat-pumps/index.qmd) introduces the methods and findings from our [2024 paper](../publications/index.qmd#xie-2024-heat-pumps).

[CIBSE Journal announcement](https://www.cibsejournal.com/cibse-news/building-simulation-award-winners-announced/) · [CIBSE’s account of the winning entry](https://www.cibse.org/get-involved/special-interest-groups/all-sig-news/cibse-building-simulation-awards-2024-the-winning-entry-of-xiaoxiong-xie-university-of-plymouth/)

## Selected invited talks {#invited-talks}

- **July 2026 · Sun Yat-Sen University** — *Impact of urban climate on building energy use and overheating*. School of Atmospheric Science.
- **November 2025 · CIBSE South West webinar** — *Simulating buildings in the urban environment*.
- **July 2025 · IBPSA Education webinar** — *Multi-scale modelling of buildings in urban environments*.
- **April 2025 · University of Birmingham** — *Indoor and urban thermal resilience in a changing climate*. 12th Urban Fluid Mechanics meeting.

## Professional service and memberships {#professional-service}

- **CIBSE AM11 revision:** contributing urban-scale simulation guidance to *Building Performance Modelling* (in progress).
- **Associate Fellow of the Higher Education Academy (AFHEA)**.
- **Secretary, Early Career Committee**, International Association for Urban Climate (IAUC), 2026–2028.
- **Member**, International Building Performance Simulation Association (IBPSA).
- **Graduate Member**, Chartered Institution of Building Services Engineers (CIBSE).
